Earlier scenes:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。他的妈妈觉得在墓地玩儿，害得，所以他们搬家。搬家对孟子有好的影响，他才五岁，可是每天不是写字就是帮妈妈的工作。

This scene:
他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人：很聪明

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他很聪明的人：他是一个很聪明的人，A noun phrase used as the predicate needs the copula and a suitable measure word here. [rule: none]
2. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 难怪他成为：难怪成为，After the same subject has just been mentioned, use zero form rather than repeating the pronoun. [rule: redundancy_delete]
3. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 成为有名的人：成为了有名的人，Use 了 because becoming a well-known person is presented as a completed result in the story. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: “他很聪明的人” cannot use the noun 人 after an adjectival predicate without a copula structure or deletion of 人.
The pronoun 他 is acceptable at the start of the new clause, and the displayed phrase is cut off before its complement.
Becoming a famous person is a completed narrative result here, so 成为了 is appropriate.
